metadata.description: Typed proof failure detection + type-specific LLM repair vs ARGOS single-strategy baseline

failure_type_taxonomy.TYPE_1_LEXICAL_MISMATCH: Predicate absent from KB but similar one exists
failure_type_taxonomy.TYPE_2_ARITY_MISMATCH: Predicate exists but called with wrong arity
failure_type_taxonomy.TYPE_3_MISSING_FACT: Proof search exhausted — missing ground fact
